description: Generic English shop labels and native home control icon masks for normalized 1920x1080 recognition.
source: UI-only crops derived from owner-supplied game screenshots and visually inspected; original screenshots and personal calibration remain private.
credit: Epic Seven, Smilegate and respective game/artwork rights holders. Software GPL does not relicense third-party game artwork.
processing: Existing grayscale text labels retained byte-for-byte. Native icon is a tightly cropped binary mask of its four white question-mark components, from an authorized STOVE home capture on 2026-10-04. No wallpaper, account details or original screen is included. Sanctuary and Epic Pass binary UI masks were isolated from the same authorized STOVE controls capture; matching their joint layout does not require wallpaper or OCR text.
